news.t: Olise double sees Bayern cruise in German Cup as Kane rested
news.desc: Bayern Munich did not need the services of Ballon d'Or winner Harry Kane and left the England captain on the bench as they cruised to a 6-1 German Cup victory over second-division side Magdeburg on Wednesday.

news.t: Bayern honor Kane for Ballon d'Or win before German Cup rout
news.desc: Ballon D'Or winner Harry Kane received a guard of honor from Bayern Munich before a German Cup second-round rout of second-tier FC Magdeburg on Wednesday.

news.t: Bayern Munich's Vincent Kompany improving 'day by day,' but no return date yet
news.desc: Bayern Munich assistant coach Aaron Danks said head coach Vincent Kompany is in good spirits and improving "day by day" after being hospitalized last week.

news.t: Bayern 'know how to deal with' Jamal Musiala seizures - Vincent Kompany
news.desc: Bayern Munich coach Vincent Kompany says it wouldn't be "a big deal" if star attacking midfielder Jamal Musiala were to collapse again as he copes with a neurological issue which causes seizures.

news.t: Bayern boss Kompany won't 'pressure' Musiala after collapses
news.desc: Bayern Munich coach Vincent Kompany said Wednesday that Jamal Musiala could be available to play soon, but added he wouldn't pressure the Germany star to return to the field until he was ready.
